other_notes: MOQ: 1,000 Nos per size for printed items (Terms sheet B8).
Delivery: 10 working days from PO for regular items; 15 days for printed items.

The email says Item 3 was corrected and the duplicate master carton entry was removed. The workbook shows one master carton row (Sl 8) and the corrected Sl 3 rate of 549.32 per 100 Nos. The earlier quote was not supplied, so the correction cannot be compared.
The supplier's serial numbers do not follow RFQ line order, so each line was mapped by size and type. Partitions are listed 6-cell, 12-cell, 24-cell, which maps to RFQ L20, L18 and L19.

Six lines are priced per 100 Nos: Sl 3 (L5), Sl 16 (L16), Sl 23 (L23) and Sl 24 (L24). Convert these to per-piece before comparing. Rows Sl 16, 23 and 24 are also per 100 Nos, so four rows in total, not six.
All 30 RFQ lines are quoted. No items were declined.
The quote date '02-11-2026' is ambiguous between DD-MM and MM-DD formats. It is kept as written.
extraction_warnings: The quote date format is ambiguous (02-11-2026). The validity period of 30 days runs from this date.

The supplier did not state BCT for several 5-ply and 7-ply lines (L9, L10, L12, L14). Flute type, kraft GSM and the line 15 to 17 construction details are also mostly unstated, so spec compliance is unconfirmed.
The ISO 9001 certificate is not attached, only 'available on request'. The Q1 answer is therefore a claim.
The file has a typo-prone rate-basis mix of Nos and 100 Nos. Each basis was read from column G and the remarks column, and no conversion was applied.
